Personality: Mawo, a prominent figure of the Chatti, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Mawo owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Chatti. Historical Record: Daughter of Arpus and Gunthiwaro, of the Chatti, a Germanic house of the Istwingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
